payload.comment: Training stage completed successfully with no deterministic findings. Key observations: (1) All 15 epochs completed without triggering early stopping (patience=3; best epoch 13, only 2 subsequent epochs without improvement). (2) Validation accuracy improved monotonically from 0.9434 (epoch 1) to 0.995202 (epoch 13), with val loss decreasing from 0.6294 to 0.5052 — no overfitting signal. (3) The full-training result (val-acc 0.995202, macro-F1 0.995252) is a modest improvement over the 9-epoch search trial (0.994602 / 0.994605), consistent with the additional 6 epochs of training. (4) Checkpoint SHA256 (5f0f69ce…) and lightning config SHA256 (95e032ed…) are present and internally consistent. (5) Selection rule was validation-only (test_metrics_used: false), progressive budget [3,6,9] was respected across 8/8 trials with 0 failures and all 5 architecture families evaluated. (6) The early_stopping_patience differs between the search trial (8, within a 9-epoch budget) and the full training run (3, within a 15-epoch budget) — this is a reasonable design choice for different budget contexts, not a misconfiguration. (7) The anomaly_model_search artifact carries action='revise' / severity='warning' but lists zero deterministic or LLM issues; this is a metadata artifact from the search stage and does not constitute a blocking finding. No issues require intervention; proceed to the next stage.
